title: Tailwise Autoship Discount Schedule by Program
content:
Tailwise Autoship pays its savings shipment by shipment, and the figures differ by program. This schedule lists, for each of the six Tailwise Autoship programs, the first-order discount, the recurring discount and the coupon terms that apply to every shipment of a subscription held in that program.

## Schedule

| | Everyday | Litter & Bulk | Fresh & Frozen | Custom Meal Plan | Pharmacy | Compounded Pharmacy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| First-order discount, percent of the merchandise subtotal | 35 | 35 | 30 | 50 | 20 | 0 |
| First-order discount cap per subscription (USD) | 20.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 | 40.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 |
| New-to-Autoship look-back (calendar days) | 365 | 365 | 365 | 730 | 365 | 365 |
| Recurring discount, percent of the merchandise subtotal | 5 | 5 | 5 | 0 | 5 | 0 |
| Recurring discount cap per shipment (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 | 10.00 | 0.00 |
| Ship-now shipment receives the recurring discount | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Promotional coupon may be combined with the Autoship discount | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Ceiling on Autoship discount and coupon together, percent of the merchandise subtotal | 40 | 40 | 30 | 50 | 20 | 0 |

## What each line means

- **First-order discount and its cap.** The percent taken off the merchandise subtotal of the first shipment of a customer who is new to Autoship, and the most that discount can be on one subscription.
- **New-to-Autoship look-back.** A customer is new to Autoship when no Autoship shipment was charged on any of their subscriptions within this many calendar days before the enrollment date. Autoship Custom Meal Plan looks back 730 days; every other program looks back 365 days.
- **Recurring discount and its cap.** The percent taken off the merchandise subtotal of every shipment after the first, and the most that discount can be on one shipment.
- **Ship-now.** Whether an on-demand ship-now shipment receives the recurring discount.
- **Coupon combination and ceiling.** Whether a promotional coupon may be combined with the Autoship discount on the same shipment, and the ceiling on the Autoship discount plus the coupon discount, as a percent of the merchandise subtotal.

## Reading the schedule

- Autoship Compounded Pharmacy shows 0 on every discount line: its shipments carry no first-order and no recurring Autoship discount, and no coupon may be combined.
- Autoship Custom Meal Plan carries the largest first-order discount (50 percent, capped at 40.00 USD) and no recurring discount (0 percent, cap 0.00 USD), and its ship-now line reads No.
- Coupons combine only on Autoship Everyday and Autoship Litter & Bulk; on the other four programs the coupon line reads No.

### Worked figures (hypothetical merchandise subtotals)

| Program | Hypothetical subtotal | Recurring percent applied | Result before cap | Cap | Recurring discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Autoship Everyday | 120.00 USD | 5 percent | 6.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 6.00 USD |
| Autoship Fresh & Frozen | 400.00 USD | 5 percent | 20.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 15.00 USD |
| Autoship Pharmacy | 240.00 USD | 5 percent | 12.00 USD | 10.00 USD | 10.00 USD |

The subtotals are invented for illustration; only the percents and caps are schedule figures.
